office_does: The sheriff runs the Benton County Sheriff's Office, the county's chief law-enforcement agency, which patrols, makes arrests and serves court orders and warrants.
race_blurb: Appointed Sheriff Mike Clark, picked by commissioners in November 2025 after Sheriff Tom Croskrey resigned mid-term, faces Republican deputy, former legislator and Kennewick council member Brad Klippert. The winner serves the short term left on Croskrey's term and then the full four-year term. Clark took 69.5% in the primary.

candidates.summary: Benton County Sheriff since his November 2025 appointment, a 23-year veteran of the office who rose from corrections officer to lieutenant and SWAT incident commander.
highlights: Appointed sheriff by county commissioners after Croskrey's resignation; earlier led community services, training and SWAT [S7][S8]
Promises to comb through the budget to stretch existing resources [S5][S3]
Runs on holding offenders accountable and proactive, data-driven policing with regional partners [S3]
Endorsed by the county Republican Party, all three commissioners, Tri-Cities mayors and 31 sitting Washington sheriffs [S4]

experience.basis: Sitting appointed sheriff with 23 years in the office and broad institutional backing.

spending.basis: Emphasizes combing through the budget, efficiency and responsible use of taxpayer resources rather than new spending.

safety.basis: Platform centers on offender accountability, case development, proactive policing and enforcement technology.

candidates.summary: Benton County sheriff's deputy since 1999, former 14-year state representative, retired Washington State Guard colonel and Kennewick City Council member.
highlights: Deputy since 1999 and school resource officer; 8th District state representative, 2008-2022 [S2][S4]
Says he will support, equip and 'invest in' deputies and keep Benton County safe [S1][S3]
Promises transparency, fairness and a sheriff who listens [S1]
As a legislator backed the death penalty for 'swift and sure justice' [S7]

experience.basis: Long service as deputy, legislator and Guard commander, but challenging the incumbent without having led the agency.

safety.basis: Enforcement and officer-support platform, with a record of backing capital punishment as a legislator.
